answer: Latent Correlation Scoring. Agents’ transaction graphs are clustered after the fact; clusters whose internal tie density exceeds a sparrow-like rarity threshold flag as one operator. A shared timing signature, the willow pattern of synchronized bursts, raises cluster confidence without any single signal being decisive. Enforcement: identities in a flagged cluster lose reputation weight and payouts retroactively. Each fake identity costs the attacker a full behavioral history plus ongoing coordination overhead, making sybils linear-cost rather than near-free.
